|------|----------------|

Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on **20 June 2026**:

**Summary**
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Slot range | 14,590,799 – 14,597,998 |
| Total blocks | 7,180 |
| Avg arrival | **1,710 ms** |
| Median arrival | **1,453 ms** |
| P95 arrival | **3,126 ms** |
| Min arrival | **141 ms** |
| Max arrival | **5,249 ms** |
